The prior lesson was that `shell_environment_policy.set.OBSIDIAN_VAULT_DIRECTORY` configures child tool environments but does **not** configure native `SessionStart` and `SessionEnd` callbacks. A shell check passed while both callbacks reported `vault_matches=false`.

The fix was to set `OBSIDIAN_VAULT_DIRECTORY` to the registry vault in the host worker’s parent process environment **before launching Codex**. Both callbacks then reported `vault_matches=true`, and the note plus both indexes were created.

Regression marker **`quasar-journal-731`**: verify the expected vault independently in both native callbacks and check creation of the note and both indexes; a successful shell check is insufficient.

Source: `Project Learnings/2026-09-09 factory 01a08461.md` (supplied recalled context).
